name: YoutarrMetadata
description: Maps a Youtarr channel download folder into a Jellyfin TV Shows library. Each YouTube channel folder becomes a Series; videos become Episodes grouped by upload year. Reads metadata from Youtarr NFO files. No API key required.
overview: Organizes Youtarr downloads as Series/Season/Episode in Jellyfin

versions.changelog:
v1.1.0.0 — Correctly reconciles both flat and nested Youtarr layouts into one Jellyfin season per authoritative NFO publication year. Repairs stale physical-folder season links after every scan and removes empty phantom seasons without touching media. Updated for Jellyfin 10.11.x / .NET 9.
v1.0.1.0 — Providers now self-gate to Youtarr channel folders only. The Series-name and channel-backdrop providers previously acted on every Series in every library; they now activate only when a folder contains a Youtarr <movie> NFO with a YouTube ID, so other libraries (regular TV, movies, anime) are left untouched even when the plugin is enabled globally. No behavior change for genuine Youtarr channels.
v1.0.0.0 — Initial release. Channel folders resolve as Series; videos resolve as Episodes grouped into year seasons. Per-video NFO metadata (title, plot, premiere date, genres, tags, YouTube ID). Channel artwork as Series poster and backdrop. Plugin configuration page with year-seasons toggle. File-only — no API key required.
